name: cinematic-soul-strings-soprano
style: English psych folk funk, heavy psychedelic funk, 100 BPM: a cool, unbothered South London baritone with a Brixton lilt, low and smoky, rich, rounded and unhurried, glottal stops and dropped H's, almost murmuring through the verses in easy spoken patter, half-crooned, never rapped, a crafty music-hall raconteur leaning on the bar, slow and swaggering, then warming into a big theatrical, soulful full-throated melody for the hook, a crowd of mates chanting back. Isaac Hayes-style cinematic soul strings: violins and cellos swelling slowly beneath the verses. Hooks and bridge only: a lone soprano's wordless operatic line drifting far back in the echo chamber, never the lead.
